title: Ali Cafe
text: Ali Cafe Our story began with a single thought. To stop people from thinking instant coffee was terrible. And to transform tastebuds with one sachet of Alicafe, one mug and hot water. Born in 1999 in Johor Bahru, Malaysia we wanted to share this vision of great instant coffee & tea. And so, we took our products inspired by the herbs of the rainforest, Eurycoma Longifolia Jack (Tongkat Ali) and Labisia Pumilia (Kacip Fatimah) to 48 countries around the world and in 2006, to the Middle East. Driven by our passion to lift the taboo from instant coffee, we dreamed. Invented. Created. Invested. Transformed. And finally, we succeeded. title: MBT in “A Week Without Sugar”
text: As part of its commitment to social responsibility and community health, MBT Group , in collaboration with Abdul Latif Jameel Hospital in Saudi Arabia, took part in the “A Week Without Sugar” initiative. During the event, samples of the locally produced Monk Fruit —a safe and healthy third-generation sugar alternative—were distributed to employees and visitors. Through this meaningful participation, MBT Group reaffirms its dedication to supporting health awareness programs, encouraging healthier lifestyle choices, and contributing to a future with better well-being for the community.

title: Indonesian Trade Delegation Visits MBT, Jeddah
text: As a prominent Saudi trading partner with Indonesian enterprises, MBT was privileged to host Mrs. Fajriyani, Director of the Export Development Directorate of Indonesia, along with her official government delegation. The discussions centered on identifying collaborative opportunities and fortifying commercial partnerships between MBT and Indonesian firms, with the goal of delivering strategic advantages for both parties.

title: Business & Social Responsibility
text: As part of MBT Group’s mission to support the community and encourage healthy living, and in collaboration with Abdul Latif Jameel , the official Toyota dealer in Saudi Arabia, samples of the Indonesian Product ‘ Monk Fruit ‘—a healthy alternative to sugar and the next-generation safe sweetener—were handed out today to the employees at Auto Hub on Madinah Road, Jeddah. The Abdul Latif Jameel team expressed their appreciation for this initiative and admiration for the product, wishing all participants ongoing health and wellness.
